get.description: The models this API key can call, each version under its own name.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or expired.

post.description: Answer a conversation with a model. Every call is logged without its content, unless the model keeps request inputs and answers.

200.description: The answer, or with stream set, server-sent chat.completion.chunk events.

400.description: response_format is not valid or cannot be applied.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or expired.

403.description: The API key does not cover this model.

409.description: The version was trained on base weights that have changed since.

422.description: The answer does not match response_format, or the body is not valid.

503.description: No engine is serving this model right now.

post.summary: Rate or correct a chat completion
post.description: The feedback waits in the review queue; accepted answers join the model's next training data.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or expired.

403.description: The API key does not cover this model.

422.description: The model is a base model, or the body is not valid.

id.title: Id
id.description: The response id; send it as response_id to POST /feedback.

model.title: Model
model.description: A name from GET /models: a custom model follows its live version, name@3 pins version 3, and a served base model goes by its key.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The conversation. A custom model answers the last user message; a base model reads them all.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The most tokens to answer with. Unset: up to the model's context limit.

max_completion_tokens.title: Max Completion Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: The same as max_tokens, under its newer name; it wins when both are set.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: 0 to 2: higher is more varied, 0 picks the likeliest token every time. Unset: the model's default; custom models answer at 0, the way their scores were measured.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Above 0, up to 1: sample only from the likeliest tokens whose probabilities add up to top_p.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Sample only from the k likeliest tokens. An extension vLLM and SGLang share.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: 0 to 1: drop tokens less likely than min_p times the likeliest one. An engine extension.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: -2 to 2: above 0 favours tokens that have not appeared yet.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: -2 to 2: above 0 lowers a token's odds the more often it appeared.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Above 0, up to 2: above 1 discourages repeating any token seen so far. An engine extension.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Sample the same way for the same seed and inputs, as far as the engine allows.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Up to 4 texts that end the answer; the text itself is not returned.

n.title: N
n.description: How many answers; only 1 is supported.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Send the answer as server-sent events, ending with data: [DONE].

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: stop when the answer ended, length when max_tokens cut it.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model name the completion was requested from, such as support-triage.

response_id.title: Response Id
response_id.description: The id of the chat completion, as the gateway returned it.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: up when the answer was right, down when it was wrong.

correction.title: Correction
correction.description: The right answer, when the rating is down and it is known.

input.title: Input
input.description: The user message the model answered. Required unless the model keeps request inputs and answers.

output.title: Output
output.description: The answer the app received, when the model does not keep it.

canonical_form.title: Canonical Form
canonical_form.default: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the card serialised as JSON with keys sorted, no whitespace and non-ASCII characters kept, as json.dumps(card, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) writes it

id.title: Id
id.description: The name to send as model.

apiKey.description: A minibrain API key, created on Deployments. It covers one or more models.
